name: Joezer
overview: Joezer was a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified specifically as a Korahite. His designation as the Korahite highlights his lineage within the clan descended from Korah, a notable family group within the Levites. This affiliation situates him within the priestly tribe, known for their service in the tabernacle and temple.
namesAndTitles: The name Joezer means 'y-h-v-h is help,' reflecting a theologically significant Hebrew name that acknowledges the Lord as a helper. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 12:6, was not given by God but carries a meaning that points to divine assistance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Joezer as a descendant of Korah, linking him to the Korahite family line. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are documented for Joezer in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Joezer's significance in Scripture arises from his identity as a Korahite Levite, a group entrusted with important religious duties in Israel. His mention in 1 Chronicles 12:6 places him among those connected to the Levitical heritage, which is central to the worship and service of God. Although brief, his identification contributes to the broader understanding of the Levitical clans and their role in God's covenant community.
